items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight missed practice. If OUT with Ja'Kobi Lane already on IR, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring Week 1; day-to-day but missed Wed/Thu.
items.implication: Bateman becomes WR1 option; Andrews target share boost possible.
items.opportunity: Lane IR opens snaps; Flowers absence expands for remaining WRs.

items.text: Nico Collins hamstring Wednesday; MRI crucial. Ran 37/42 routes Week 1 on Stroud dropbacks. Missed 5 games 2024 on hammy. Hierarchy if out: Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15.
items.why: High route share + injury history raises concern.
items.implication: Fantasy managers need contingency; Boutte/Hutchinson waiver/flex upside.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second straight day with back injury.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 vs Texans; Chase/Higgins impact if limited.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) says ready to go for Week 2 vs Steelers after missing opener; full practice reported.
items.why: Ankle injury Week 1; self-declared ready via Reiss.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps, 40% routes targeted. RB1 overall in range of outcomes vs IND (gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry).
Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan) in Kubiak debut; 19% target share last 10 games. Overreaction to injury scare; 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) placed on IR/return; beneficiary Bateman/Moore noted in waivers.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Bateman and depth WRs.

items.text: W2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse if in). Deebo top waiver.
items.why: Precise injury fallouts and role expansions.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE (bounceback): 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks Week 1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR; 6th-most PPG to WRs recently.
items.why: Strong usage + soft matchup after tough W1.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches Week 1. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz. CHI allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Miller rush attempts W1, 69% points via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; Saints 8.5-pt underdogs @ BAL not run-friendly.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Miller reverse beneficiary if Kamara out.

items.text: Rookie Kenyon Sadiq (16th pick) optimistic debut: 28 snaps despite missing OTAs/camp mostly (hernia). Schemed goal-line carry, screen, two other targets. Clear intent to get him ball.
